scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run publint
scripts.publint: pnpm --filter @deviltea/tiny-state-machine exec publint && pnpm --filter @deviltea/tiny-state-machine-vue exec publint && pnpm --filter @deviltea/ef exec publint && pnpm --filter @deviltea/widget-core exec publint && pnpm --filter @deviltea/widget-vue exec publint
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm --filter @deviltea/eslint-config run test:package && pnpm --filter @deviltea/ef run test:package && pnpm --filter @deviltea/tsconfig run test:contracts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && pnpm --filter vue-temp-var run type-check
